teaser: "You're out the door before the vote," a friend says, watching you leave before the meeting even ends. Close enough to true. Life path 1 sets you toward building something that answers to your own name on it, and ESTP decides fast, moves faster, trusts what the body reads in a room over any slow deliberation. The crossing is a person who leads by doing, not by announcing first — picking up the tool, taking the first swing, letting the plan catch up on the way down. What's worth noticing is what gets left out: the patience to let a vision sit quietly before it gets used.
